item.title: New Lab members and new Lab name!
item.description: We warmly welcome Xuan and Yi to join us! We are aslo proud to announce that we have integrated our research directions and accordingly changed the name of our laboratory to "Plant IDEA Lab". Plant IDEA Lab: Plant Interactions, Design, and Environmental Adaptation Our lab aims to investigate how plants sense, respond to, and adapt to their environment. Our research integrates plant evolution, nutrient signaling, and plant-environment interactions with cutting-edge approaches in design biology and synthetic biology.
